items.question: What is the minimum validity period a passport must have to enter the UAE, measured from the date of entry?
items.gold: Passports must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of entry into the UAE.
items.fact: UAE passport must be valid six months from entry

items.question: Can citizens of some countries get a visa on arrival when entering the UAE?
items.gold: Yes, citizens of several countries can get a visa on arrival.
items.fact: Several nationalities eligible for UAE visa on arrival
